function optional(value: { kind: 'a'; entry: string | null } | { kind: 'b'; entry: number }) {
  if (value.entry === null) {
    const incorrectlyNarrowed: 'a' = value.kind;
  }
}
function mixed(value: { kind: 'a'; entry: string | null } | { kind: 'b'; entry: number | undefined }) {
  if (value.entry === undefined) {
    const incorrectlyNarrowed: 'b' = value.kind;
  }
}
function shared(value: { tag: 'same'; left: number } | { tag: 'same'; right: number }) {
  if (value.tag === undefined) {
    const impossibleParent: never = value;
  }
}

function impossibleNumber(value: number) {
  if (value === undefined) {
    const invalid: string = undefined;
  }
}
function impossibleBoolean(value: boolean) {
  if (undefined == value) {
    const invalid: typeof value = undefined;
  }
}
function impossibleTypeof() {
  if (typeof undefined === 'string') {
    const invalid: string = undefined;
  }
}
